bio: Welcome to Harvard, Class of 2029! My name is Ruth Jaensubhakij (she/her), and I am a second-year proctor and a 2L at the law school. I graduated from Harvard College in 2022, where I studied Social Studies and Ethnicity, Migration, & Rights. After graduating, I spent a year in Chiang Mai, Thailand, working for an anti human trafficking organization, and then a year in New York City working in the non-profit performing arts world. As an undergrad, I was involved with a Capella and theatre, the international student community, public service & advocacy groups, faith-based organizations, and PAFing. Come talk to me about being an international student, pursuing the performing arts at Harvard, pathways to law school, and public service/human rights work!
